**Restore `NodeBoundary` state when `eval_evaluated_with` unwinds.**

`NodeBoundary::enter` can install a local cap and an evidence frame, and `start` can change the node cursors. `eval_evaluated_with` calls `evaluate(ctx)` before `finish`. If a callback panics during evaluation, `NodeBoundary` has no `Drop` implementation, so these changes remain in `EvalCtx`. A later evaluation can then use stale state.

Add an RAII guard that owns the `&mut EvalCtx` and `NodeBoundary`, calls `abort` on drop, and disarms only after `finish` returns. The previous `eval_evaluated_inner_with` restored state only on returned errors and did not provide unwind cleanup.
